Fails when duplicated LINES exceed threshold% of scanned lines — a drift-stopper, not a zero-duplication mandate (barrel exports, fixture boilerplate and lookup tables are accepted duplication; see docs/reviews/analysis-tools-plan-2026-08-07.md). Baseline at adoption 2026-08-07: 4.9%. Threshold 5.5 = ~+2,000 duplicated lines of headroom before red. Investigate a breach with: npx jscpd --reporters consoleFull src scripts tests
